scope: 11 interpretation checks; no change to frozen design or thresholds

items.name: simpson_paradox
items.reason: Average and per-point results are both shown; final mean improvement does not override MJ3 failure or ATU5 paired MAE regression.

items.name: ecological_fallacy
items.reason: Four-point average cannot describe every point or other landslides; no family-wide claim.

items.name: berkson_paradox
items.assessment: not identified as a design mechanism
items.reason: No sample inclusion is conditioned on favorable model scores; all fixed points/dates/seeds kept. Earlier research choices remain exploratory.

items.name: collider_bias
items.reason: No physical causal graph or adjustment-effect claim. Correlated K/H masks and shared driving do not identify separate physical mechanisms.

items.name: base_rate_fallacy
items.reason: Displacement/interval study contains no warning classifier or hazard probability interpretation.

items.name: regression_to_mean
items.reason: Changing periods and repeated refits can improve after poor windows without stable model benefit; all three windows and paired seeds retained.

items.name: survivorship_bias
items.reason: Both new arms completed all24 fits regardless of scores; oldDATA/PHYS and five controls retained with exact source arrays.

items.name: look_elsewhere_effect
items.reason: Design is informed by prior exposed results. No p-values or confirmatory significance; no final-window champion selection.

items.name: garden_of_forking_paths
items.reason: Masks, budget, seeds, gates and outputs committed before training; future gated-branch idea is a new hypothesis, not a successful result.

items.name: correlation_vs_causation
items.reason: Factor contrasts concern the specified retraining procedure and metric nonadditivity; they do not show physical interactions or failure causes.

items.name: reverse_causation
items.reason: Teacher states derive from fixed fitted physics. Legitimate time boundaries audited, but neither time order nor source legality proves directional physical causation.

independence: Overlapping origins/windows, adjacent errors and three seeds are not independent scientific replicates.
calibration: Same previous-path legal error-pool rule for all arms; marginal Gaussian intervals do not guarantee simultaneous293-day coverage.
